mapper.select: SELECT MS_WEEK_1JAN AS MS_WEEK, MS_MONTH, MS_START_DATE AS MS_START_DATE, MS_END_DATE AS MS_END_DATE FROM NV_TB_ATT_WEEK_MON_TO_SUN /*WHERE MS_MONTH BETWEEN to_char(add_months(sysdate, -2),'rrrrmm') AND to_char(TRUNC(sysdate), 'rrrrmm') -- 2018.01.31 박귀희 : ValueSet 과 조건 맞춤 */ WHERE MS_MONTH >= TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -1),'RRRRMM') AND TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(MS_START_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), 'YYYYMM') <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMM') and MS_WEEK_1JAN = #{msWeek1jan}

SELECT om.organization_id as code, om.org_name_local as name FROM tb_att_contract_n tac, org_master om WHERE tac.time_attend_contact_user_id = #{employeeNum} and tac.subsidiary_code = #{subsidiaryCode} and tac.organization_id = om.organization_id UNION SELECT OM.ORGANIZATION_ID AS code ,OM.ORG_NAME_LOCAL AS NAME FROM ORG_MASTER OM WHERE om.org_end_date is NULL START WITH om.organization_id = #{organizationId} CONNECT BY PRIOR om.organization_id = om.parent_org_id ORDER BY NAME
